When I got my wisdom teeth out, the person who drove me home as I was wacked out on anesthesia said I was very loudly proclaiming I was gonna go home and “fuck up Taniks”

I’m proud of that fact
The Taniks arena in DSC was the functional equivalent of a local cafe for me
Never forget: It’s smarter to be lucky than it’s lucky to be smart
you could put a fishing mini game in anything and I'm gonna play it
I think the coolest part is that we are all posting from our various blockchain-backed NFT-managed plots in the metaverse and paying for everything with DookieBux

Two brothers working for @unicef.org distributing water to displaced Palestinians in Gaza City were killed by Israeli soldiers on April 17. UNICEF expressed "outrage" and called for accountability.

Full story and more from Gaza at our website - link in bio. 

youtu.be/iTj-s45hT8Y

"so much for the tolerant left"

tolerate this steel pipe with your skull, actually
Bring back consequences for being an absolute, unbridled piece of shit instead of, idk, electing them into office

Anyway, I actually *do* think that if your default stance on ICE’s migrant concentration camps is "well I don’t care what conditions they have, they’re illegal!" then you should be dragged through the town square for being the antisocial fuck that you are in the face of mass human suffering

I know its bad faith and they’re just a moron, but I truly just once want someone to explain their reasoning here. "Law says this, so we should build concentration camps and I'm okay with that implying that if I happen to get caught up in a raid, I'm just fucked"

(ofc they havent thought of that)

Me: "Your tax dollars are being used to abuse migrants and hold them in concentration camps where their basic human rights are violated daily"

Commenter: "So what? They’re illegal!"

Aw shit I’ve been found out

I am a fraud who has only ever pretended to greet people 😭
Is the opposite of "out of pocket" just... "in pocket"???
